principal_risks: Pattern definitions may be subjective and vulnerable to hindsight bias.
required_future_data: Governed historical OHLCV data with an explicit timeframe
research_questions: Can rejection events be specified causally and tested without discretionary relabeling?

principal_risks: Anchor selection may introduce discretion, instability, and hindsight bias.
required_future_data: Governed historical OHLCV data with reproducible swing annotations
research_questions: Can anchor selection and evaluation be made causal, deterministic, and auditable?

principal_risks: Sparse observations and overnight gaps may distort historical conclusions.
required_future_data: Governed H4 OHLCV history with session and gap metadata
research_questions: Which causal swing hypotheses merit formal specification and independent validation?

principal_risks: Timestamp revisions, publication latency, and surprise definitions can create look-ahead bias.
required_future_data: Governed point-in-time macro releases and publication timestamps
research_questions: Can event information be aligned using only what was available at each decision time?

entries.display_name: M1 and M5 scalping and short-horizon trend research
principal_risks: Costs, spread, latency, and market microstructure can dominate short-horizon results.
required_future_data: Governed M1 and M5 market data with spread and quality metadata
research_questions: Do any causal short-horizon hypotheses survive realistic costs and out-of-sample validation?

principal_risks: Long holding periods expose research to gaps, regime shifts, and survivorship bias.
required_future_data: Governed daily OHLCV history with corporate-action and survivorship controls where relevant
research_questions: Which long-horizon hypotheses remain stable across instruments, regimes, and held-out periods?

principal_risks: Selection logic can amplify overfitting, data leakage, and false confidence.
required_future_data: Governed multi-regime histories and independently validated strategy evidence
research_questions: Can regimes and selection decisions be defined causally without ranking by in-sample profitability?

principal_risks: Daylight-saving changes, auction mechanics, gaps, and liquidity variation may invalidate naive comparisons.
required_future_data: Governed exchange calendars, session metadata, and intraday market data
research_questions: Can session boundaries and opening observations be normalized without look-ahead information?

principal_risks: Level construction may be discretionary, unstable, and prone to hindsight bias.
required_future_data: Governed historical OHLCV data with causal level-construction inputs
research_questions: Can levels and rejection observations be defined before outcomes are known?
